claims.claim: The remediation receipt job now runs only when the issue title is exactly [AIOS REMEDIATION INTENT]. Admission has the same title guard, and dispatch depends on admission.

The workflow change is limited to the receipt job condition. Its reusable dispatch inputs, profile attribution, bounded receipt logic, and failing rejected-outcome step remain unchanged for target issues.

Repository-owned regression tests now inspect the remediation job graph and rejection path, plus the existing title isolation of the PRIMARY wakeup, Brain Ingress, and REPAIR wakeup workflows. Those three workflow files were unchanged.
